Sorry your FNB transactions have stopped coming through. The "Reconnect required" message means your bank has expired the connection. Most banks require this every 90 days.

expected.body: Got an email that my payment failed. Will my account be shut off? I'm travelling until next week.

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

Thanks for getting in touch. Your account won't be shut off straight away. Here's what happens:

- Your account stays fully active for 14 days after the first failed payment.
- We'll retry your card automatically after 3 days and again after 7 days, and email you each time.
- If the payment still hasn't gone through after 14 days, your account becomes read-only. You'll still be able to view and download invoices, but you won't be able to create new ones until the payment succeeds.

If you're back next week, you should have time to sort it out before then. When you're ready:

1. Go to Settings > Billing > Payment method.
2. Add a new card.
3. Click "Retry payment".

Access is restored as soon as the payment succeeds.

Common reasons a payment fails are an expired card, insufficient funds, or your bank blocking an online transaction. Since you're travelling, it may be worth checking with your bank. Kettle charges appear on statements as "KETTLE APP".

expected.subject: Connect PayFast
expected.body: How do I add a pay now button for PayFast on my invoices?

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

To add a "Pay now" button to your invoices:

1. Go to Settings > Payments.
2. Connect your PayFast account.

Once it's connected, your invoices will show a "Pay now" button. A few things worth knowing:

- When PayFast confirms a payment, the invoice is marked Paid automatically, usually within a few minutes.
- If an invoice still shows Unpaid after your client has paid, check that the payment appears in your PayFast dashboard. Then mark the invoice paid manually from the invoice menu.
- Card payments reach your account on PayFast's payout schedule, not Kettle's.
- Kettle doesn't hold your money. If you need to refund a client, do it in your PayFast dashboard.

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

We know you're up against a 5pm deadline, so the steps below are the fastest way back in.

For security, passwords are reset using a link sent to your email rather than sent to you directly. Here's how:

1. Go to the Kettle login page and click "Forgot password".
2. Enter the email address your account was created with.
3. Open the reset link in the email and choose a new password. The link is valid for 30 minutes and can only be used once.

If the email doesn't arrive within 5 minutes, check your spam folder and make sure you used the email address the account was created with. If you request a new link, any older links stop working, so always use the most recent one.

Kettle staff will never ask for your password, so please don't send it to us.
